description_en: Queries a list of host accounts that the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is authorized to manage
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-host-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationHostAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host whose accounts you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html operation to query the host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name

HostAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户列表

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether a password is configured for the host account.

true

false
HasPassword.description_zh:
当前主机账户是否设置了密码。

true：已设置密码。
false：未设置密码

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the shared key that is associated with the host

PrivateKeyFingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint of the private key for the host account
PrivateKeyFingerprint.description_zh: 主机账户的私钥指纹信息

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol that is used by the host account.

SSH

RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机账户的协议名称。
SSH
RDP

SSHConfig.description_en: Indicates whether the Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) channels or the SSH channels are enabled for the host account that uses the SSH protocol

EnableSFTPChannel.description_en: Indicates whether SFTP channels are enabled for the account

EnableSSHChannel.description_en: Indicates whether SSH channels are enabled for the account

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of host accounts returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户总数量
